meta.title: Privacy policy: analytics only with consent · Fizlet
meta.description: What fizlet.com collects, why and for how long: no analytics, hosting logs, and how to opt out. No ads, no selling data.

title.accent: Analytics only if you say yes.

lead: Fizlet has no accounts, sells nothing, runs no analytics and shows no ads. This page says what is collected and who processes it.
by: By Chris Cooley ↗ · Last updated 2026-10-31

blocks.title: Who we are
blocks.body: Fizlet is an open-source (MIT) micro game and animation engine for the DOM, made by Chris Cooley under the coded.design ↗ name. "We" means the people behind that project. This policy covers fizlet.com. The games have their own site, DOM VIRUS ↗, with its own policy.

blocks.title: What we collect
blocks.body: Nothing that identifies you by name. There is no sign-up, no login and no form. The demos run in your browser and send nothing of their own.

blocks.title: Analytics
blocks.body: None. The site loads no analytics script, makes no analytics request and sets no analytics cookie.

blocks.title: Hosting and request logs
blocks.body: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub receives the details every browser sends with a request, such as your IP address, and may log them under its own privacy statement ↗.

blocks.title: Children
blocks.body: The site is for a general audience and asks nobody for personal information, children included.

blocks.title: Changes to this policy
blocks.body: If what we collect changes, we update this page and its date first. Every change is public in the site's GitHub history ↗.
